message.reasoning_content:
The vendor has been on file since August 2024 with no earlier invoices in the ledger.

The invoice totals $19,790. Findings F1 through F4 are reject-severity and require rejection. The response must cite each finding ID in its reasons and address all four findings. A brief summary for the finance manager is also needed.

The $50 tax discrepancy confirms finding F1. Stock levels for WidgetA, WidgetB, and GadgetX are all below the ledger quantities. The low risk memo does not override these reject findings. The payment gate blocks approval.

STOCK_EXCEEDED is also reject-severity. Stock levels for WidgetA, WidgetB, and GadgetX all exceed ledger quantities. This blocks payment even if the $50 tax gap is explained as shipping. The schema requires finding IDs in every reason. A reason about the low risk memo may not cite any findings.
